author: Zephyr I
title: Stacked ConvLSTM x2 (default PG)
abstract: Depth ablation: two stacked ConvLSTM layers on top of a residual CNN, with default policy-gradient training and fixed hyperparameters to isolate the effect of deeper spatial memory.

original_submission.content:
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 47

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Fix all except depth; match prior best width for comparability
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

class ConvLSTMCell(nn.Module):
    features: int
    kernel_size: Tuple[int, int] = (3, 3)
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, carry, x):
        h, c = carry
        gates = nn.Conv(4 * self.features, self.kernel_size, padding='SAME',
                        kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(jnp.concatenate([x, h], axis=-1))
        i, f, g, o = jnp.split(gates, 4, axis=-1)
        i = nn.sigmoid(i); f = nn.sigmoid(f); o = nn.sigmoid(o); g = jnp.tanh(g)
        c = f * c + i * g
        h = o * jnp.tanh(c)
        return (h, c), h

class ResidualBlock(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Conv(self.features, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(y)
        return nn.relu(x + y)

class CNNConvLSTM2(nn.Module):
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    conv_lstm_features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        B = x.shape[0]
        # CNN backbone
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_1, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_1)(x)
        x = nn.Conv(self.cnn_features_2, (3,3), padding='SAME',
                    kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = ResidualBlock(self.cnn_features_2)(x)
        # Init/Reset stacked states
        if rnn_state is None:
            zeros = lambda: jnp.zeros((B, 8, 8, self.conv_lstm_features), dtype=x.dtype)
            rnn_state = {'h1': zeros(), 'c1': zeros(), 'h2': zeros(), 'c2': zeros()}
        if done is not None:
            m = (1.0 - done.reshape(B,1,1,1).astype(x.dtype))
            rnn_state = {
                'h1': rnn_state['h1'] * m, 'c1': rnn_state['c1'] * m,
                'h2': rnn_state['h2'] * m, 'c2': rnn_state['c2'] * m,
            }
        # Layer 1
        (h1, c1), y1 = ConvLSTMCell(self.conv_lstm_features)((rnn_state['h1'], rnn_state['c1']), x)
        # Layer 2
        (h2, c2), y2 = ConvLSTMCell(self.conv_lstm_features)((rnn_state['h2'], rnn_state['c2']), y1)
        rnn_state = {'h1': h1, 'c1': c1, 'h2': h2, 'c2': c2}
        # Heads on top layer
        z = y2.reshape((B, -1))
        z = nn.Dense(256, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); z = nn.relu(z)
        pol_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); pol_h = nn.relu(pol_h)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(4, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(pol_h)
        val_h = nn.Dense(64, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(z); val_h = nn.relu(val_h)
        value = nn.Dense(1, kernel_init=nn.initializers.xavier_uniform())(val_h).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    return CNNConvLSTM2(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
    )
